Definition: A #[tauri::command] function exposed to the desktop GUI through the Tauri invoke_handler.
An app-local SQLite database (openpipestress-projects.sqlite3) holding projects, rule packs, and private libraries that are never committed or transmitted.
An idempotent versioned SQLite migration applied on open and tracked via PRAGMA user_version, with target version 11.
In-document model schema migration evaluated on open/persist; migrated documents append a ledger record while the schema version authority stays in-document.
A user-controlled rule-check document (schemas/rule_pack.schema.yaml) persisted only locally and validated/checksummed via core/rules.
An automatic rule-pack check run against a solved model emitting only status vocabulary and no professional/compliance claim.
Aggregate/check status emitted when a required rule-check input is unsupplied or unresolvable — the check blocks rather than silently passing.
A rule-pack required-input source kind resolved at run time from the local private-library store and never embedded in the rule pack (IP boundary).
An additive in-pack reference binding a solver_result input to a solved-envelope result row; it governs its input alone and cannot be overridden by a caller selector.
Validation of a parsed material/section/component import payload (DEL-03-07 port); only an accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY import is stored.
Library-import outcome for suspected protected content; the import is refused and never written to the local store.
The DEC-018 SI dual-display unit catalog with si_canonical calculation basis and entered_units_preserved storage convention.
Deterministic hash-bound HTML report rendering with protected-content gates and a non-hash-bound derived print view naming the canonical hash.
A background preview-mechanics solve job with cooperative (not preemptive) cancellation checkpoints tracked in an in-memory registry.
The linear-static preview solve over a PreviewModel producing a solved mechanics envelope with results and diagnostics.
The invariant that software outputs are findings only and make no professional, certification, sealing, authentication, approval, or code-compliance claim.
A structured model edit routed through validate/apply operations rather than raw model-file mutation, requiring user acceptance.
A SQLite FTS5 full-text index over project name and serialized model/envelope text for local project search.
An evidence record appended when a migrated model document is persisted, carrying pre/post model hashes, source schema version, and applied migration ids.
